items.html: *And it is found that the bringing out of Bina to the outside is through the corrections mentioned in the Song of Songs, and they enter within ZA and become a brain for him, and from there it spreads throughout the whole body. And the Hochma itself is corrected from its own side, and brings out for him a second brain through Bina; and this brain has no spreading throughout the whole body, because of the abundance of its concealment; and therefore he is called the son of Rivka and not the son of Yitzchak, as is stated in the Idra Zuta, because its essence is from Bina, and it is the life of the King; and therefore its brain precedes the brain that spreads from the Hochma.
